name: np2 TAB5
description: PC-9801 emulator for the M5Stack Tab5, based on NP2kai. A compatible BIOS and font are built in, so it boots from a blank microSD card - put disk images in the card's root and pick them from the on-screen menu. USB and Bluetooth LE keyboard and mouse, the touch panel as the PC-98 mouse, screenshots to PNG, and USB modes that show the SD card or the mounted hard disk image to a PC.
keywords: PC-9801, PC-98, emulator, NP2kai, retro, ESP32-P4, Tab5
author: mochimochi-man / Uh
